summary: GrowInLove is a relationship-focused web app built on the Internet Computer (Motoko canister backend + React SPA frontend). Users authenticate via Internet Identity, initialize a simple profile (name), pair with a partner using a 6‑digit code, and then complete a daily ritual prompt by submitting optional text, emoji, and/or an uploaded photo. The app includes partner synchronization for daily ritual completion, a Memories archive fed by ritual history, a Love Languages quiz with partner sync (combined and partner-specific state), and an Insights dashboard UI for streak/harmony/trends/badges (currently backed by stubbed analytics endpoints). An Activities hub provides a love-language spin wheel and unlockable activity packs (largely UI-driven / placeholder for future backend challenges). The backend also includes authorization bootstrap/roles and canister blob-storage maintenance endpoints.

existing_features.title: Internet Identity authentication (login/logout + delegation restoration)
existing_features.description: Provides an authentication context around @dfinity/auth-client that restores a saved delegation on mount, exposes login/logout, and surfaces status flags used across the SPA.

existing_features.title: Identity-bound canister actor creation with access-control bootstrap via URL-hash secret
existing_features.description: Creates an anonymous actor when unauthenticated and an identity-bound actor when authenticated; on authenticated actor creation, bootstraps backend access control using a secret token sourced from the URL hash/session, and invalidates/refetches dependent queries when the actor changes.

existing_features.title: Role-based access control (admin/user/guest) with env-token initialization and role assignment
existing_features.description: Backend maintains principal→role mapping, supports initialization against an environment admin token, exposes role/admin queries, and supports admin-only role assignment.

existing_features.title: User profile onboarding and management (initialize/get/save)
existing_features.description: Authenticated users initialize a profile (name). The app supports reading/updating the caller’s profile and prevents direct mutation of role/isFirstUser/partnerId fields.

existing_features.title: Partner pairing via 6-digit code (generate/check/complete) with mutual partnership enforcement
existing_features.description: Implements pairing code creation and completion with validations (profile required, no self-pairing, no already-paired users). After pairing, both profiles are updated with partnerId and couple access becomes available.

existing_features.title: Daily ritual prompt rotation with Love Language tagging and prompt library endpoints
existing_features.description: Backend lazily initializes a fixed prompt set and returns the day’s prompt via day-number modulo prompt count, with an optional LoveLanguage tag; also exposes prompt listing and filtering endpoints.

existing_features.title: Ritual response submission (text/emoji/photo) with reactive UI updates
existing_features.description: Users submit a daily ritual response containing optional text, emoji, and photoId; the frontend invalidates/refetches ritual status, ritual history, insights data, and badge milestones so the UI updates without a full reload.

existing_features.title: Canonical ritual completion attribution (partnerA/partnerB) and polling-based sync
existing_features.description: Backend returns a canonical partnerA/partnerB ordering (principal text ordering). The frontend derives callerComplete/partnerComplete by comparing the caller principal to partnerA/partnerB and polls every 5 seconds for partner completion.

existing_features.title: Ritual completion celebration animation
existing_features.description: When both partners complete the ritual, the UI displays a transient floating-hearts overlay and renders the latest ritual responses inline.

existing_features.title: Ritual history UI and Memories archive (expand/modal details + photos)
existing_features.description: Displays ritual history entries in Home and Memories, with formatted dates, love-language focus labels, expandable/modal detail views, and inline photo rendering via stored photo blobs.

existing_features.title: Shared photo upload/storage/retrieval/listing/deletion
existing_features.description: Backend stores photo blobs and metadata, enforces access for owner/partner/admin, supports listing photos by user, and allows deletion by owner/admin; frontend uploads with preview, then references photoId in ritual responses.

existing_features.title: Love Languages quiz UI (7 questions) with scoring, sharing, and retake/reset
existing_features.description: Implements a multi-step quiz with scoring/ranking, saves results to the backend, supports viewing persisted results, sharing via Web Share/clipboard, and resetting/retaking with confirmation and error handling.

existing_features.title: Combined quiz synchronization state (caller+partner results) with polling
existing_features.description: Backend exposes a combined caller/partner completion+results view; frontend polls it to show waiting/synced status, render partner rankings, and compute a top-3 overlap harmony score.

existing_features.title: Partner quiz state endpoint with authorization + frontend partner quiz hook wiring
existing_features.description: Backend provides getPartnerQuizState(partnerId) with authorization (must be mutually paired or admin; cannot query self). Frontend derives partnerId from the cached caller profile, calls the endpoint, polls for completion, and falls back safely if the endpoint is unavailable on older backends.

existing_features.title: Insights dashboard UI (streak/harmony/trends/badges) with deterministic trend rendering and badge celebration overlay
existing_features.description: Renders streak/harmony overview, deterministic 7-day history derived from backend trend series, milestone badge progress, and a celebration overlay when a new badge unlock is detected; supports auto-scroll to the harmony section via sessionStorage flag.

existing_features.title: Harmony UI utilities and components (percent, normalization, trend direction)
existing_features.description: Shared utilities convert harmony 0..1 values to percent, normalize trend series to 7 values, infer up/down/stable direction, and supply display metadata used in Home and Insights harmony widgets.

existing_features.title: Activities hub (spin wheel + unlockable activity packs + admin override)
existing_features.description: Activities page includes placeholder Love Challenges and Reward Visuals sections, a spin wheel weighted toward shared/top quiz results with one spin per day persisted in localStorage, and activity packs unlocked by streak thresholds with an admin override to unlock all packs.

existing_features.title: Admin UX (admin checks, badges, and pairing bypass for certain pages)
existing_features.description: Frontend queries admin status, shows prominent admin UI markers, and allows admin users to access Insights/Activities even without being paired.

existing_features.title: Secure URL secret handling (hash-only extraction + session persistence + URL cleanup)
existing_features.description: Utilities extract sensitive parameters from the URL hash fragment (not querystring), persist them in sessionStorage, and remove them from the address bar via history.replaceState to reduce leakage.

existing_features.title: Blob-storage maintenance endpoints (gateway registry, dead-blob pruning, cashier refill)
existing_features.description: Backend exposes maintenance APIs to refresh authorized gateway principals from a cashier canister, list dead blobs, confirm pruning and trigger Motoko GC, and refill the cashier with cycles (cashier-authorized).

existing_features.title: Manual QA acceptance checklist for core flows and partner-sync determinism
existing_features.description: Repository includes a detailed manual QA checklist covering pairing, ritual submission modes, history/memories, streak/harmony/badge stability across reload/devices, couple isolation, quiz persistence/synchronization, and canonical ritual completion attribution.

existing_features.title: Update the frontend data flow (React Query + any consuming UI) to match the backend’s multi-entry ritual history behavior, ensuring the Home and Memories pages correctly display multiple days and still treat ritualHistory[0] as the latest entry because results are sorted newest-first and limited.

new_feature_requests.summary: Step 2A: Fix backend ritual history to be true multi-day (append-only per coupleId+day), update submitRitualResponse storage model, and make getRitualHistory(limit) return sorted multi-entry history reliably

Update the backend ritual storage model so ritual entries are stored append-only per coupleId AND per day (e.g., a unique key derived from coupleId + day number), instead of overwriting a single entry per coupleId. Ensure that submitting a ritual response for the same couple on the same day updates the same day’s entry (merging responses by userId), and submitting on a different day creates a new entry without affecting prior days.

Update backend endpoints that currently assume a single ritual entry per couple so they work with the new per-day storage: (1) getRitualStatus must reflect today’s ritual completion status for the couple (based on today’s day key), and (2) getRitualHistory(limit) must return a list of RitualEntryView across multiple days, sorted reliably by date (newest first) and respecting the provided limit argument.

architectural_notes: Frontend is a tab-based React SPA (no react-router); navigation is handled by local state in App.tsx and a fixed BottomNav.

Canister interactions are centralized into React Query hooks (frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts) with explicit cache invalidation/refetch after mutations and polling for partner sync (ritual/quiz/insights).
Authentication uses a custom InternetIdentityProvider wrapping @dfinity/auth-client with delegation restoration; login/logout state is exposed via hooks.

A useActor() hook builds an anonymous or identity-bound canister actor and bootstraps backend access control via _initializeAccessControlWithSecret using a token sourced from URL hash (persisted in sessionStorage and removed from URL).
Backend composes functionality via Motoko mixins (authorization + blob-storage maintenance) included into the main actor.
Couple-scoped isolation is deterministic via a coupleId derived by sorting partner principals (as text) and mutual partnership verification for couple data access.
UI stack is Tailwind + shadcn-ui with OKLCH design tokens and multiple custom animations (badge celebration, glow pulses, floating hearts, one-time post-pairing highlight).
Client persistence is used for UX state (localStorage: post-pairing highlight flag, spin-wheel daily result; sessionStorage: secrets and Insights auto-scroll flag).
Photos are stored in-canister as blobs and rendered in the UI via ExternalBlob direct URLs.
Backend now uses stable storage with preupgrade/postupgrade hooks to preserve core app state across canister upgrades.
known_issues: Backend analytics endpoints getInsightsData() and getBadgeMilestones() currently return stub/empty values (zeros and empty arrays), so Insights/Harmony/Badges UI will not reflect real couple state yet.
Ritual history is effectively single-entry per couple: ritualEntries is keyed only by coupleId and is overwritten; getRitualHistory ignores its limit argument and returns at most one entry.

React Query is configured with nested QueryClientProviders (frontend/src/main.tsx and frontend/src/App.tsx), which is redundant and can cause cache/context mismatches if hooks are ever used outside the inner provider.

Several React Query hooks are enabled even when unauthenticated because an anonymous actor exists; calling user-only backend methods as anonymous can trap and produce noisy errors (e.g., getCallerUserProfile, isAdmin).

Access-control bootstrap can trap for the first user: initializeUserProfile attempts AccessControl.assignRole(...) for first user admin promotion; if the caller was not already admin via _initializeAccessControlWithSecret, assignRole traps (admin-only).
_caffeineStorageUpdateGatewayPrincipals() lacks any authorization guard; any caller can mutate the authorized gateway principal list used for blob-maintenance authorization.

Blob-storage cashier env var is misspelled (CAFFFEINE_STORAGE_CASHIER_PRINCIPAL); misconfiguration will trap. Additionally, refillCashier uses Nat.sub(balance, reservedCycles) which can trap if balance < reservedCycles.
getDailyRitual() is implemented as an update call (shared) rather than a query, increasing latency for a read-mostly endpoint.
Pairing codes have no actual expiration logic despite errors/types suggesting expiry (e.g., ExpiredCode), and codePool is unused beyond local tracking.
